rules.statement: An ice temperature reading must be a finite number, or it is rejected.
rules.subject: ice reading temperature

rules.statement: The ice counts as too warm only when its temperature is above the warm threshold. A reading at or below the threshold resets the warm period.
rules.subject: ice temperature

rules.statement: The next session is put on hold once the ice has stayed too warm for at least the warm-hold window.
rules.subject: continuous warm ice duration

rules.statement: Only a session that is open can be put on hold because of warm ice.
rules.subject: session status for hold

evidence.quote: if (s.status !== "on-hold") throw new DomainError(409, "session is not on hold");

rules.statement: A manager can release or cancel a session only while it is on hold.
rules.subject: session status for release/cancel

rules.statement: When a held session is cancelled, a paid booking is refunded through PuckPay only if its amount is greater than zero. Free member entries are just cancelled.
rules.subject: paid booking refund amount

rules.statement: A held session is cancelled only after every ticket refund succeeds. If any refund fails, the session stays on hold.
rules.subject: refund failures on session cancellation

rules.statement: The session considered for a hold is the earliest one that is not cancelled and has not started yet (its start is now or later).
rules.subject: next session start time

rules.statement: When a session is put on hold, only holders of paid or pending bookings with a phone number get the hold text message.
rules.subject: hold notification recipients
